d:
Bihar ke mokama aur barh ilake men 'chhote sarkar' ke nam se mashhur anant sinh ke kshetr men jediyu emaelsi niraj kumar alag andaj men najar aae. pandarak ke sury mandir men puja-archana karne pahunche niraj kumar ka samarthakon ne chandi ka mukut pahnakar svagat kiya. is dauran 'bare sarkar jindabad' ke nare bhi lage. emaelsi chunav men anant sinh ne niraj kumar ka virodh kiya tha. aise men is svagat aur naron ke kya hain siyasi mayne?
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
Welcome to Bihar Tak
